reader_question: Which parts of the atlas connect to which?
grade_line: Graded by the atlas, connection by connection: our count of its 118 connections by region, as of October 15, 2026
title: The atlas’s 118 connections fill 44 of the 100 pairs of its ten regions, and 32 of the connections stay within one region.
measure_line: Connections in the atlas’s model, counted by the region each starts in (rows) and the region it reaches (columns), as of October 15, 2026
notes: A connection joins two variables in the atlas’s model, from the one that acts to the one it affects. A cell counts the connections between two regions and gives no measure of their strength.

Lines of authority, such as Congress deciding public investment levels or the executive setting tariff rates, carry no plus or minus sign in the atlas. All seven start in governing institutions and are the only connections in three cells, which the grid draws with an outline.
Outside drivers, conditions the atlas treats as given, such as geography, receive no connection.
The download lists the connections in each cell by their atlas IDs.
alt: A grid of the atlas’s ten regions, rows for where a connection starts and columns for where it ends. Forty-four of the 100 cells hold connections, from one to seven each, and the diagonal holds the 32 that stay within a region. Governing institutions starts 23, the most, among them all seven lines of authority; no connection reaches outside drivers.

notes_internal: Maker B, round 3. Data plan row 95 with change 1, rule 14.105. Draws the derived v7-region-connection-matrix (from v7-links-with-regions), V7 snapshot October 15, 2026; where drops the 56 empty pairs, so the table lists the 44 filled cells as links (from, to, count), R3-6.

Data lead ruling (a): no named mark, the matrix answers with its pattern; (b): four sequential steps 1; 2 or 3; 4 or 5; 6 or 7 on seq-1, seq-3, seq-4 and seq-5, seq-1 with the context edge; empty cells the ground in a gridline; the seven lines of authority in three cells with no fill and a 1.5 px edge in the text's ink; no split by sign; the table gives plus, minus and no sign per cell with the connection IDs as typed chips (every ID in v7.ids).

Figures checked by maker_b_round3_derive.py --figures (check S74): 118 connections, 44 of 100 cells filled, 32 within a region (the diagonal), governing institutions starts 23 (the most), all 7 authority connections start there and fill three cells, outside drivers receives 0, counts run 1 to 7. The two example lines of authority are LE02's and LE19's names in V7.

Weight (D3-1097): the table drops the connection IDs (118 typed chips, about 8,000 bytes on the page); the CSV export keeps link_ids for every cell and note 4 says so; v7.ids is empty since no ID prints.
chart_notes: A filled cell’s shade grows stronger with its count, which is printed in it. Lines of authority, which carry no sign, are the only connections in three cells, drawn with an outline and no shade.
